## Part 2: Crossed vs. nested

1.  Blood samples taken from 4 individual animals, each sampled at 3 time points.
2.  Soil cores taken from 5 plots nested within 3 sites, with plots physically distinct per site.
3.  Behavioral observations made by one of 3 observers, where each observer records data at every one of 6 field sites.
